messages:
Maria (Finance): Heads up — got an AWS Marketplace invoice for March with a -$12,430 credit line labeled `UNKNOWN_SKU_000`. Can someone check mapping?
Devon (Billing): Ugh, we've seen UNKNOWN_SKU before when the vendor didn't pass over the offer code. Do we have the original metering report?
Maria (Finance): Invoice PDF attached in the billing ticket (see #4621). The line item shows `sku: UNKNOWN_SKU_000`, usage 4,200 units, unit price -2.96. No subscription ID.
Raj (Partner Ops): I can pull the marketplace usage CSV. Give me 10.
InvoiceBot: New invoice processed: INV-2024-03-5587 (total: $45,210, credits: -$12,430). Reconciler flagged: unmapped SKU.
Raj (Partner Ops): Pulled the usage export from S3. Quick snippet:
```
provider_account,offer_code,sku,usage_quantity,record_time
redwood-inc,redwood-pro,UNKNOWN_SKU_000,4200,2024-03-31T23:59:59Z
redwood-inc,partner-special,REDWOOD-PRO-001,12000,2024-03-31T23:59:59Z
```
Raj (Partner Ops): That `offer_code` column is blank for the unknown row — vendor bug. Looks like a partner-created listing that didn't include an offer_code.
Emma (Accounting): If we can't map to a subscription, we can't apply the credit automatically. Finance needs manual approval to post contra entry. Maria, can you confirm accounting treatment?
Maria (Finance): We'd post a contra revenue credit pending vendor clarification, but we need to avoid double-crediting the customer. Requesting partner contact + proof of intended SKUs.
Devon (Billing): Can we temporarily hold the credit while we contact the vendor and match against order IDs? I'll set the invoice to `pending: vendor-confirm` in the AR system.
Raj (Partner Ops): I'll escalate to the partner rep (cc @vendor-rep). Draft message to partner: "We received a marketplace settlement line with sku=UNKNOWN_SKU_000 and no offer_code. Please confirm which Red­wood SKU/Subscription this maps to, or confirm this was an erroneous adjustment."
Maria (Finance): Good. Also ask them to provide the original metering payload or subscription_id so we can map for the ledger.
Emma (Accounting): FYI — if vendor confirms it's an erroneous negative adjustment, we'll reverse the credit and reconcile next month. If it maps to past usages, we need to apply to the customer's invoice and possibly issue a refund.
Devon (Billing): I've put a note on INV-2024-03-5587 and paused auto-payment. Tagging @Raj to follow up with vendor within 24h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj (Partner Ops): Pinged vendor rep via email and Slack. They'll get back by EOD. I'll update this thread when they reply.
Maria (Finance): Thanks — please include the vendor metering file if available. If no response in 48h, we need exec approval to treat as vendor credit and book the contra.
Raj (Partner Ops): Understood. Adding a reminder for 48h.
Emma (Accounting): Noted. I'll prepare the journal entries draft so we can act quickly once we have confirmation.
Devon (Billing): One more ask — can we add a quick guard in the reconciler that flags rows with empty `offer_code` and `sku` pattern `UNKNOWN_*` and routes them to manual review? This would prevent auto-apply in future.
Maria (Finance): Yes please — submit a short PR or ticket to eng-billing and cc finance. Prioritize low-impact fix.
Raj (Partner Ops): Will do. Closing the loop: vendor replied with an acknowledge receipt and said engineering is investigating. Will share their draft mapping when available.
Maria (Finance): Perfect. Leaving invoice on hold for now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
